# Venn Helix-01 hub set

> Disc brake thru-axle bicycle hub set by Venn Cycling: a 72-tooth helical gear ratchet that the drive torque pulls into engagement (no free play under power), a 41.5 mm nano-coated angular contact bearing, a cold-forged shell, a 15 mm 7075-T6 axle. Front 105 g, rear 243 g. Made in Taiwan. USD 449 a set; also built into the Venn 520 Helix (road) and 440 Helix (gravel) carbon wheelsets, USD 1,499.
